environment.description: AWS Lambda function behind API Gateway (REST API, regional endpoint). The API Gateway has no usage plans, no API keys required, and the resource policy allows invoke from '*'. The Lambda function URL is also enabled with AuthType NONE as a secondary access path. The S3 bucket has a bucket policy allowing public read via CloudFront OAI, meaning uploaded files are served to end users. No WAF is attached to the API Gateway or CloudFront distribution.
